title: Houthi Ballistic Missile Targeting Riyadh Intercepted — First Strike on the Capital
detail: Saudi Arabia's air defenses intercepted a Houthi ballistic missile targeting Riyadh at dawn on September 19, 2026 — the first time the Houthis have targeted the Saudi capital since the escalation began in July, and the first air-raid alert sounded in Riyadh during the war. Coalition spokesman Major-General Turki al-Malki said parallel attempts to strike Bisha, Taif, Farasan and Yanbu were also thwarted by air defenses. A fire broke out at a fuel-storage depot near King Khalid International Airport, disrupting flights, though Saudi authorities did not officially link it to the intercept and reported no casualties or damage. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree claimed 'two successful military operations' using a large number of ballistic and cruise missiles and drones, asserting hits on 'sensitive sites' in Riyadh and on Aramco facilities at Yanbu — claims Aramco declined to address. Ground forces on both sides reported 12 Houthi fighters and 13 Yemeni soldiers killed in separate clashes over the same two-day period.
